free_tier.stated: The allowance was real and is now gone. Quoted from the Cirrus Labs announcement dated 7 April 2026: 'Cirrus CI will shut down effective Monday, June 1, 2026.' Quoted from the docs before the shutdown: free for OSS up to 'a cap of 50 compute credits a month', equal to '10,000 CPU-minutes for Linux tasks or 500 minutes for macOS tasks which always use 4 CPUs', with per-platform concurrency of 16 CPUs Linux, 16 CPUs Arm Linux, 8 CPUs Windows, 8 CPUs FreeBSD and 4 CPUs with 1 VM on macOS, and a single task capped at 8 CPUs on Linux. Cutoff 'for a job that has a full runtime' was 2 hours per task.
